# Archive Record

## Summary
The single writer for sending any record out of the working set: writes `recordStatus` to Archived on the card it is given, legality checked against the Record Status block's transition graph before the write. A record that never carried a status is treated as live, so first-time archiving needs no backfill. Re-fetches the card before reading (a caller's copy may have unloaded links) and is idempotent — archiving an archived record reports, it does not throw.

## Usage
```ts
import ArchiveRecordCommand from '@cardstack/catalog/fields/record-status/commands/archive-record';

await new ArchiveRecordCommand(commandContext).execute({ card: record } as any);
```
Restore Record, beside it in `fields/record-status/commands/`, is the way back. The target is any card carrying the Record Status field.

## Non-goals
Hiding archived records is each consumer's query filter — the command writes one fact and nothing else. Hard deletion stays the platform's file-delete. Domain lifecycles (a paid invoice, a done task) are untouched; record lifecycle is deliberately a separate axis.
attributes.cardDescription: Moves any record carrying the Record Status field to Archived, checked against its transition graph, and reports rather than throws when it is already archived.
